beats.note: On net earnings, after stream costs.

items.t: Track every stream cost (net, not gross)
Part of SE tax comes off your income
Pay estimates so April isn't a shock

captions.instagram:
Made $400 or more streaming GTA VI this year? 🎮 There's a second tax most streamers miss.

Myth: "It's side money, so it's only income tax."
Fact: net self-employment earnings of $400 or more mean self-employment tax too: your Social Security and Medicare, figured on Schedule SE.

✔️ It's on net earnings, so track every stream cost.
✔️ The employer-equivalent part comes off your income for income tax.
✔️ Pay estimates so April isn't a shock.

Comment STREAM with your creator tax question.

Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.
captions.youtube_description: Net self-employment earnings of $400 or more mean you file and owe self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare) on Schedule SE, on top of income tax. It is figured on net earnings after business costs, and the employer-equivalent portion is deductible in figuring adjusted gross income. Source: IRS 'Self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare taxes)'. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.
captions.pinterest_description: Net $400+ from streaming means self-employment tax on Schedule SE, on top of income tax. Track costs; pay estimates. Source: IRS.

sources.fact: SE tax 15.3% (12.4% SS + 2.9% Medicare); net SE earnings $400+; Schedule SE; employer-equivalent portion deductible for AGI
